name: zeta
formula: zeta = 1 - sum_k |grad rho_k . u_k| / sum_k |grad rho_k|
references: Tier-1 charge-density descriptor set

name: m1
formula: m1 = sum_k rho_k r_k / sum_k rho_k

name: m2
formula: m2 = sum_k rho_k r_k^2 / sum_k rho_k

name: sigma_r2
formula: sigma_r2 = m2 - m1^2

name: f_core
formula: f_core = sum_{k: r <= c1} rho_k / sum_k rho_k

name: f_bond
formula: f_bond = sum_{k: c1 < r <= c2} rho_k / sum_k rho_k

name: f_int
formula: f_int = sum_{k: r > c2} rho_k / sum_k rho_k

name: lnf
formula: lnf = (1/N) sum_k 1(lap rho_k < 0)

name: lnf_charge_weighted
formula: lnf_charge_weighted = sum_{lap rho_k < 0} rho_k / sum_k rho_k

name: lap_concentration
formula: lap_concentration = sum_{lap rho < 0} |lap rho_k| / sum_k |lap rho_k|

name: lap_concentration_valence
formula: lap_concentration_valence = sum_{r > c1, lap rho < 0} |lap rho_k| / sum_{r > c1} |lap rho_k|

name: ellip_bond_avg
formula: ellip_bond_avg = mean of lambda1/lambda2 - 1 over {k in bond, lambda2 < 0}

name: ellip_bond_std
formula: ellip_bond_std = std of lambda1/lambda2 - 1 over {k in bond, lambda2 < 0}

name: f_H_negative
formula: f_H_negative = (1/N_bond) sum_{k in bond} 1(H_k < 0),  H = g + v

name: H_bond_mean
formula: H_bond_mean = <H_k> over the bond shell,  H = g + v = (1/4) lap rho - g (a.u.)

name: G_over_rho
formula: G_over_rho = <g_k / rho_k> over the bond shell (a.u.)

name: f_ELF_localized
formula: f_ELF_localized = (1/N_bond) sum_{k in bond} 1(ELF_k > 0.5)

name: ELF_bond_avg
formula: ELF_bond_avg = <ELF_k> over the bond shell

name: ELF_core_valence_contrast
formula: ELF_core_valence_contrast = <ELF>_core / <ELF>_bond

name: zeta_ELF
formula: zeta_ELF = 1 - sum_k |grad ELF_k . u_k| / sum_k |grad ELF_k|

name: f_NCI
formula: f_NCI = (1/N) sum_k 1(s_k < 0.5 and rho_k < 0.05 a.u.),  s = |grad rho| / (2 (3 pi^2)^(1/3) rho^(4/3))

name: NCI_attractive
formula: NCI_attractive = fraction of NCI voxels with lambda2 < 0

name: sign_lambda2_rho_mean
formula: sign_lambda2_rho_mean = mean of sign(lambda2) rho_k over NCI voxels (rho in a.u.)

name: V_spread
formula: V_spread = std over sites i of V(R_i)

name: V_int_min
formula: V_int_min = min over interstitial voxels of V_k (cell average of V set to 0)

name: rho_mid_mean
formula: rho_mid_mean = mean of rho at nearest-neighbour bond midpoints

name: rho_mid_std
formula: rho_mid_std = std of rho at nearest-neighbour bond midpoints

name: m1_def
formula: m1_def = sum_k |drho_k| r_k / sum_k |drho_k|,  drho = rho - promolecule

name: m2_def
formula: m2_def = sum_k |drho_k| r_k^2 / sum_k |drho_k|

name: sigma_r2_def
formula: sigma_r2_def = m2_def - m1_def^2

name: f_bond_def
formula: f_bond_def = sum_{k in bond, drho > 0} drho_k / sum_{drho > 0} drho_k

name: f_int_def
formula: f_int_def = sum_{k in int, drho > 0} drho_k / sum_{drho > 0} drho_k

name: f_bond_dep
formula: f_bond_dep = sum_{k in bond, drho < 0} |drho_k| / sum_{drho < 0} |drho_k|

name: def_polarity
formula: def_polarity = sum_k |drho_k| dV / Q_tot,  Q_tot = sum_k rho_k dV

name: bond_charge_transfer_pair_mean
formula: bond_charge_transfer_pair_mean = mean over nearest-neighbour pairs of int_{region(i,j)} drho dV

name: bond_charge_transfer_pair_std
formula: bond_charge_transfer_pair_std = std over nearest-neighbour pairs of int_{region(i,j)} drho dV

name: m1_def_out
formula: m1_def_out = sum |drho_k| r_k / sum |drho_k| over voxels outside every PAW augmentation sphere (r > R_PAW of the nearest nucleus)

name: m2_def_out
formula: m2_def_out = sum |drho_k| r_k^2 / sum |drho_k| over voxels outside every PAW augmentation sphere (r > R_PAW of the nearest nucleus)

name: sigma_r2_def_out
formula: sigma_r2_def_out = m2_def_out - m1_def_out^2 over voxels outside every PAW augmentation sphere (r > R_PAW of the nearest nucleus)

name: f_bond_def_out
formula: f_bond_def_out = sum_{bond, drho > 0} drho / sum_{drho > 0} drho over voxels outside every PAW augmentation sphere (r > R_PAW of the nearest nucleus)

name: f_int_def_out
formula: f_int_def_out = sum_{int, drho > 0} drho / sum_{drho > 0} drho over voxels outside every PAW augmentation sphere (r > R_PAW of the nearest nucleus)

name: f_bond_dep_out
formula: f_bond_dep_out = sum_{bond, drho < 0} |drho| / sum_{drho < 0} |drho| over voxels outside every PAW augmentation sphere (r > R_PAW of the nearest nucleus)

name: def_polarity_out
formula: def_polarity_out = sum |drho_k| dV / Q_tot over voxels outside every PAW augmentation sphere (r > R_PAW of the nearest nucleus)

name: def_out_volume_fraction
formula: def_out_volume_fraction = fraction of the cell outside every PAW augmentation sphere

name: rho_perc_a
formula: rho_perc_a = max {c : the super-level set {rho > c} spans a1 under PBC}

name: rho_perc_b
formula: rho_perc_b = max {c : the super-level set {rho > c} spans a2 under PBC}

name: rho_perc_c
formula: rho_perc_c = max {c : the super-level set {rho > c} spans a3 under PBC}

name: perc_anisotropy
formula: perc_anisotropy = (max_alpha - min_alpha) / mean_alpha of rho_perc

name: n_max
formula: n_max = (number of local maxima) / V_cell

name: n_min
formula: n_min = (number of local minima) / V_cell

name: n_saddle1
formula: n_saddle1 = (number of index-1 saddles) / V_cell

name: n_saddle2
formula: n_saddle2 = (number of index-2 saddles) / V_cell

name: n_NNM
formula: n_NNM = (number of local maxima with min_i |r - R_i| > r_cut) / V_cell

name: Q_NNM
formula: Q_NNM = (charge in the steepest-ascent basins of the non-nuclear maxima) / Q_tot

name: rho_min
formula: rho_min = min_k rho_k

name: rho_min_ratio
formula: rho_min_ratio = rho_min / <rho>_V

name: rho_int_mean
formula: rho_int_mean = mean of rho over the interstitial shell (r > c2)

name: T_eigenvalues_t1
formula: T_eigenvalues_t1 = eigenvalue 1 (ascending, t1 <= t2 <= t3) of T_ab = sum_k d_a rho_k d_b rho_k / sum_k |grad rho_k|^2 (trace 1)

name: T_eigenvalues_t2
formula: T_eigenvalues_t2 = eigenvalue 2 (ascending, t1 <= t2 <= t3) of T_ab = sum_k d_a rho_k d_b rho_k / sum_k |grad rho_k|^2 (trace 1)

name: T_eigenvalues_t3
formula: T_eigenvalues_t3 = eigenvalue 3 (ascending, t1 <= t2 <= t3) of T_ab = sum_k d_a rho_k d_b rho_k / sum_k |grad rho_k|^2 (trace 1)

name: charge_FA
formula: charge_FA = sqrt(3/2) ||T - (1/3) I||_F / ||T||_F

name: shannon_entropy
formula: shannon_entropy = -int rho~ ln rho~ dV - ln V,  rho~ = rho / N_e

name: fisher_information
formula: fisher_information = int |grad rho~|^2 / rho~ dV  (a.u.; voxels above the density floor)

name: disequilibrium
formula: disequilibrium = V int rho~^2 dV

name: LMC_complexity
formula: LMC_complexity = D e^S  (D, S the unnormalized disequilibrium and entropy; = 1 when uniform)

name: rho_min_int
formula: rho_min_int = min of rho over voxels with r > max(c2, R_PAW) of their nearest nucleus

name: rho_min_int_ratio
formula: rho_min_int_ratio = rho_min_int / <rho>_V

name: n_NNM_paw
formula: n_NNM_paw = (number of local maxima with r > max(r_cut, R_PAW,i)) / V_cell

name: Q_NNM_paw
formula: Q_NNM_paw = (charge in the basins of the maxima counted by n_NNM_paw) / Q_tot

name: M_abs_per_atom
formula: M_abs_per_atom = sum_k |m_k| dV / n_atoms

name: M_net_per_atom
formula: M_net_per_atom = |sum_k m_k dV| / n_atoms

name: m1_spin
formula: m1_spin = sum_k |m_k| r_k / sum_k |m_k|

name: sigma_r2_spin
formula: sigma_r2_spin = sum_k |m_k| r_k^2 / sum_k |m_k| - m1_spin^2

name: f_bond_spin
formula: f_bond_spin = sum_{k in bond} |m_k| / sum_k |m_k|

name: mu_site_std
formula: mu_site_std = std over i of mu_i,  mu_i = sum_k w_i(k) m_k dV

name: spin_frustration
formula: spin_frustration = 1 - |sum_i mu_i| / sum_i |mu_i|

name: spin_charge_correlation
formula: spin_charge_correlation = Pearson r(rho_k, |m_k|) over voxels

name: m1_site_std
formula: m1_site_std = std over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_k w_i(k) rho_k r_ik / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: m1_site_range
formula: m1_site_range = max - min over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_k w_i(k) rho_k r_ik / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: m1_site_max
formula: m1_site_max = max over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_k w_i(k) rho_k r_ik / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: m1_site_min
formula: m1_site_min = min over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_k w_i(k) rho_k r_ik / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: m1_within_element_var
formula: m1_within_element_var = sum_e w_e Var_{i in e} of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_k w_i(k) rho_k r_ik / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: m1_between_element_var
formula: m1_between_element_var = sum_e w_e (mean_e - mean)^2 of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_k w_i(k) rho_k r_ik / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: f_bond_site_std
formula: f_bond_site_std = std over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_{c1 < r_ik <= c2} w_i(k) rho_k / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: f_bond_site_range
formula: f_bond_site_range = max - min over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_{c1 < r_ik <= c2} w_i(k) rho_k / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: f_bond_between_element_var
formula: f_bond_between_element_var = sum_e w_e (mean_e - mean)^2 of X^(i),  X^(i) = sum_{c1 < r_ik <= c2} w_i(k) rho_k / sum_k w_i(k) rho_k

name: zeta_site_std
formula: zeta_site_std = std over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = 1 - sum_k w_i(k) |grad rho_k . u_ik| / sum_k w_i(k) |grad rho_k|

name: zeta_site_range
formula: zeta_site_range = max - min over sites of X^(i),  X^(i) = 1 - sum_k w_i(k) |grad rho_k . u_ik| / sum_k w_i(k) |grad rho_k|
